decision: SysML 8.2.2.25 states UseCaseUsage = OccurrenceUsagePrefix 'use' 'case' ConstraintUsageDeclaration CaseBody. The SysML Xtext writes ActionUsageDeclaration where the clause writes ConstraintUsageDeclaration, and factors the keyword into a keyword rule; SysML 8.2.2.17.2 and 8.2.2.20 give both declarations the same body, UsageDeclaration ValuePart?, so neither difference changes the language. The rule is the clause as written.
